name: GroqCloud

dataUsePolicy.details: Groq does not use customer data submitted via API to train models.

freeTier.notes: Generous free tier with ultra-fast LPU inference (typically 300-800 tok/sec).

notes: Free tier models: llama-3.1-8b-instant, llama-3.3-70b-versatile, mixtral-8x7b-32768, gemma2-9b-it.
